title: Avatar
description: Initials first, photo when there is one. Three sizes, a status dot, and a stacking group.
usage: Initials are the default — they never 404. Use the group for teams; cap it at 4 faces plus a count chip.
a11y: Decorative avatars (initials next to a visible name) are aria-hidden; an avatar that stands for a person on its own is role="img" with the name in aria-label (a bare aria-label on a span is not allowed for generic elements). A stack is one role="img" with a summary label. The status dot sits at the inline end (left in RTL); its state is in the label, not the color. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
